findings.title: Call to undefined method isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the superclass UsernamePasswordForm only defines isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) after this change. There is no no-arg overload in the changed file, so this file cannot compile. The call likely needs to pass context.getUser() or a no-arg helper method must be added.

findings.title: Passkey conditional UI is no longer initialized when no user is set
findings.body: The new isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) method returns false when the user is null, and it is used in UsernamePasswordForm.authenticate (line 115) and UsernamePasswordForm.challenge (line 137) to decide whether to call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(). During first-time login and after invalid-username errors, the authentication context has no user, so the WebAuthn challenge and conditional-UI attributes are not added to the login page. This regresses discoverable passkey login and passkey availability after username errors, contradicting the updated tests that expect the webauthn form to be present in those states.
